kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
JSON field extracted without validation; missing .mergeEvent.repoSlug would assign the string 'null' to repo_slug and pass it to discovery_repo_id without checking.

Refactored error handling delegates to factory_workspace_resume_fetch but error message propagation is incomplete — note initialized empty on line 67 but never set by the helper, so fail "$note" will produce a blank error if the helper fails.
jq commands parsing JSON output don't check for success; if the output file is missing or invalid, variables silently become empty strings, causing confusing test failures
